exceptions.scope: Compile-time proc-macro used only by tokenizers 0.23.2; no runtime code is shipped from it.
exceptions.evidence: cargo tree -i paste: tokenizers 0.23.2 -> airk-kernel, airk-retrieval. Unmaintained notice, no vulnerability. No compatible tokenizers release removes it.

exceptions.scope: Font parsing inside lopdf 0.42.0 for pdf-extract 0.12.1; runs only in the bounded PDF worker subprocess.
exceptions.evidence: cargo tree -i ttf-parser: lopdf 0.42.0 -> pdf-extract =0.12.1 -> airk-ingest. Unmaintained notice, no vulnerability. pdf-extract is pinned; replacing it is tracked separately.

exceptions.scope: Glob matching inside @vscode/vsce 4.0.1-3, the VSIX packaging and publishing tool; not part of the installed extension runtime.
exceptions.evidence: npm ls minimatch: @vscode/vsce -> minimatch 10.2.6. vsce latest 4.1.0 and next 4.1.1-0 still require ^10.2.6, so no compatible fix exists. vsce matches only AIRK's own fixed .vscodeignore/files patterns in CI packaging and the OIDC publish job; no untrusted pattern reaches it. Moderate denial of service, CWE-405.
